display.summary: Lighter pages: each page loads only the stylesheet of the theme in use, and switching themes loads the new one before fading to it.
highlights: Pages link only the active theme's stylesheet instead of every allowed theme's (about 425 KB of uncompressed CSS when all twelve are allowed).
Switching themes loads the new stylesheet first and then fades to it; the newest of several quick switches wins.
From 1.15.2 or earlier? This includes the 1.15.3 security fix: afterwards run ./start.sh check --fix (Composer 1.9.2+) so stored files stay private.
